instruction: The terminal bell sound is annoying and beeps every time I press backspace at the prompt. Disable the terminal bell permanently so it stays disabled even after reboot.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.write('gsettings get org.gnome.Terminal.Legacy.Profile:/org/gnome/terminal/legacy/profiles:/:$(gsettings get org.gnome.Terminal.ProfilesList default | tr -d "'")/ audible-bell'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: Task requires permanently disabling terminal bell. Evaluator opens new terminal and checks audible-bell setting using gsettings, expecting 'false'. Uses existing check_include_exclude metric with vm_terminal_output getter.
metadata.similarity_to_original: high - same pattern of OS terminal configuration that persists across reboots
